parameters.content:
Ziffr to Todoist

1. Fill in the Settings node: your Ziffr address, the Webhook's id and secret, the email address you have in Ziffr (assigneeEmail) and the id of the Todoist project.
2. Add the Todoist credential to the HTTP Request nodes.
3. Replace the Webhook path with a long random string, activate the workflow and put its production URL into the Webhook in Ziffr (events: action.created, action.updated, action.done).

Self-hosted n8n: set NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto. Details: docs/automations/todoist.md
